trail.text: Flagged deviations point to catalogue and queue — I'll dig in to isolate the true origin.
Catalogue shows strong resource strain while user and front-end look quiet — I'll check the remaining services to rule out hidden causes.
Only catalogue shows real degradation so far — now I'll pin down timing to confirm the cascade order.
Timing confirms catalogue spiked first with the downstream effects following — I'll submit the final ranking.

causes.reasoning: Catalogue shows the earliest (2s) and largest jump from 0 to ~2.2M mapped-file/cache with memory failures, CPU surge, and p90 latency 0.0048 to 0.039, indicating origin.
Host disk writes completed jumped 90 to 3806 at 4s just after catalogue memory spike, consistent with hosting the faulty catalogue container.
Queue-master FS writes/reads jumped 0.03 to 55 at 13s after catalogue with no latency/CPU change, suggesting secondary I/O pressure not root.
Orders p99 latency rose slightly 0.099 to 0.128 at 63s much later than catalogue, consistent with downstream victim of catalogue slowness.
User shows only a tiny memory-failures blip 0 to 0.013 at 44s with all other metrics flat/down, likely noise or late victim not cause.
